steps.text: A low harmonic resonance vibrates through the metal floor plates, rising from the deep oceanic current below.

steps.speaker: Nova
steps.text: Do you feel that? The pressure... it's changing.
The air grows heavy, carrying the distant echo of a song long forgotten.
You pull back to catch your breath and regroup after the defeat.
Check your gear and supplies before re-engaging. Exploiting enemy weaknesses, using Snacks, and timing defensive skills can swing the next encounter.
A security lock halts your progress.
Check your objectives or inventory—certain rooms need power restored or a keycard before they open.
Sensors flag movement beyond the doorway.
Clear nearby threats or prepare a pre-emptive strike—some exits stay sealed until the ambush is dealt with.

steps.speaker: Ollie
steps.text: Nova! There you are! We're late to meet Jed.

steps.speaker: Ollie
steps.text: Come on. If he’s started clearing the bench, we’ll have to help.
The generator catches. Work lights snap on down the tunnel, one row after another. Nova keeps her palm on the switch until it stops shaking.
Heavy locks release farther down the mine. Under the returning machinery, the strange hum is still there.
Ellie carefully packs the shattered display into a crate for repair.
Maddie hands over the grinder, hopeful you can repair it.
Kasey reluctantly passes you the cracked projector lens.
Colony camera feeds cycle through wide, close, and tracking angles for visual calibration.
The view locks, drifts, then settles as the scene framing comes online.
Status captions pulse across the feed, translating colony alarms into something readable.
The caption layer holds long enough to read before the next warning takes its place.
Narration settles over the scene like a system log with a pulse.
Emergency color grading washes the image in warning reds and cold industrial blues.
The scene fades down until only the colony hum remains.
A white impact flare swallows the frame, then snaps back to the room.
A fractured memory cuts through the present, bright at the edges and gone too fast.
The frame narrows, focusing attention on the single choice left in front of Nova.
Trade Row opens into noise, heat, and a dozen quiet deals pretending to be legal.
Every visual layer stacks together: motion, captions, filters, and the pressure of the moment.
The narrator catches the quiet detail the alarms are too loud to notice.
The camera glides across the room, letting the damage tell the story first.
Dust, sparks, and tiny motes of resonance drift through the light.
A ring of pressure ripples outward, bending the air into visible sound.
The frame jolts as something heavy hits nearby.
Motion streaks tear past the viewport as the launch rail takes hold.
The horizon tips sideways, making the corridor feel even less trustworthy.
The open square catches every sound at once: boots, vendors, distant machinery, and the low electric buzz of surveillance.
The visual effects layer blooms across the frame, then folds back into the scene.
The edges darken, pulling the eye toward the one detail that matters.
A hard transition sweeps the old room away and leaves the next danger waiting.
The view tightens slowly, closing the distance before anyone moves.
The camera pushes forward and tracks sideways, following the line of trouble through the room.
Phase sweep: 87 kHz. Cold loop: 68%. Ground phase: 180°. The three bands lock together, and the cutter stops fighting her.
The damaged cradle closes its circuit through cutter, suit, and operator. The grip turns hot—her fingers won't open.
The Cryo-Inductor fuses with a sharp pop. Her Flux Liner dumps the discharge into the stone, burning its sacrificial ground strip open.
Pain rings through her teeth and left hand. Her suit clock skips half a second. Beneath the hum, a second pulse keeps time with her breath.
The cutter drops. The Fork lifts free of its cradle—and above the mine, a Harmony sensor flashes red.
The pod’s capacitors kick it off the rail. Nova catches one last glimpse of the colony before the Chime opens the interlock and locks navigation onto its paired beacon.
Zeke wrenches at the controls, but the display snaps back to the same heading. The safe corridor slides away as the planetary shield fills the viewport.
The shield rejects the pod. White light floods the cabin—the impact shears a stabilizer loose and hurls them back toward Sector 9.

steps.speaker: Zeke
steps.text: It won't let me turn! Nova, I can't get us clear!

steps.speaker: Nova
steps.text: Look at me. Hook your arm through the frame. I'm here.
The navigation console arcs and goes dark. Zeke grips the frame beside Nova as the pod rolls into the storm. Rain hammers the hull. The thrusters sputter out.
Black branches rush across the viewport. The pod tears through the canopy and hits hard. Nova's hand is still reaching for Zeke when the lights go out.
Nova seats the cracked circuit board in the isolated socket. Encrypted commands crowd the screen. She checks the disconnected network cable before touching the keys.
A hidden block opens: overlapping wave patterns, repeated like a signature. Below them is one name: Chorus. Nova reads it twice.
ACCESS KEY WRITTEN TO REMOVABLE BOARD. NETWORK TRANSMISSION: NONE. Nova pulls the board. The recovered key clears from the terminal, leaving nothing on the network to follow her.
The discarded datapad warms in Nova's hand. Its battery warning covers half a final shift log. She lowers the brightness to keep it alive.
'They sealed the doors from outside. Called the collapse a biohazard. We only broke into a pocket of hum. We've been knocking between shifts of the drills. Nobody's answered.'
'The sound comes in waves. We count them so we don't lose track of the hours. If somebody gets this out, tell them we were still here. We didn't abandon the shift.'
The screen goes dark. Nova waits, then presses the power key once more. Nothing. She puts the datapad away instead of leaving it with the empty helmets.
SECTOR 9 // TWENTY YEARS EARLIER

steps.speaker: Lab PA
steps.text: SOURCE BEAST CONTAINMENT BREACH. FAR DOOR PRESSURE RISING.
The inner doors buckle. An operator locks the brass Chime into the tube.
Broadcast my identity. Get it away from them.
The tube fires, rocketing through the conduit.
A chord answers through the dark. The receiver needles rise together.
Mute the room. Seal me in.
The pod seals. The beacon continues in the dark.
STARBORN
Ground strip clamped. Cold loop at 68%. Nova opens the governor bypass while Jed hovers over the cut-off.

steps.speaker: Nova
steps.text: One sweep. I'm watching the heat.
The cutter arcs straight into a buried conduit beneath the bench. The breaker slams open—yet the hum keeps climbing.

steps.speaker: Jed
steps.text: Kill it, Nova!

steps.speaker: Nova
steps.text: I have. Jed... it's still answering.
CUTTER FAULT 4C-117 flashes red beside NOVA VANCE on the terminal. Far beneath the workshop, an old chamber seal cracks.

steps.speaker: Gh0st
steps.text: The order’s still in my head. I lowered the rifle anyway.

steps.speaker: Nova
steps.text: You can come with us. The rifle stays off our backs.

steps.speaker: Gh0st
steps.text: Agreed. If we find another receiver, I want to check it.

steps.speaker: Orion
steps.text: Then stay here a moment. Nova, wait for the others before you open it.
Nova opens the Bridge alone. Heat climbs her arm and her knees buckle.

steps.speaker: Orion
steps.text: Close it. Zeke, get a ground on her bracer. Gh0st, can you take her other hand?
Zeke clips a ground lead to Nova's bracer. Gh0st checks the empty command channel, then offers his armored hand.

steps.speaker: Gh0st
steps.text: I’ve got her. Go ahead.
Orion holds the counter-tone. The current divides across four willing contacts, and Nova's shaking hand steadies.

steps.speaker: Nova
steps.text: My hand’s stopped shaking. Can you both still feel the current?
Vale falls. Voices still call from the network he leaves behind. The crew holds the circuit open; five protocol signatures meet at the Key.

steps.speaker: Gh0st
steps.text: I can still hear someone on the other side. They’re asking for the door.

steps.speaker: Orion
steps.text: I hear them. Keep that line open.
Nova reaches for the Key. Around her fingers, the five signatures begin to pull into one. She opens her hand.

steps.speaker: Nova
steps.text: Ground lead failed. Zeke, manual bus. Gh0st, brace left. Orion, hold the counter-tone.
The interface rejects Zeke, so he holds the bare ground path by hand. Gh0st takes the force aimed at the crew. Orion keeps the counter-tone level.

steps.speaker: Orion
steps.text: The Key is open. Release root access when the corridor clears.
Nova opens a regional corridor, drops Vale's forced links, and releases root access. Her Source connection burns out as the network closes.
They fall together.
A long second passes. Zeke coughs. Gh0st gets an arm under him.

steps.speaker: Zeke
steps.text: Nova? Can you hear me?
Nova reaches for the Source and feels only the cold floor. Zeke’s voice reaches her through a thin, high whine.

steps.speaker: Nova
steps.text: I can hear you. Keep talking.

steps.speaker: Orion
steps.text: The corridor’s holding. I can hear people calling through it. Let’s get you up.

steps.speaker: Gh0st
steps.text: Elara? If you hear me, wait at the opening. We’re coming through.
A hand reaches back through the corridor. Gh0st catches it and pulls her clear of the closing light.

steps.speaker: Elara
steps.text: I’m here, brother. You left the light on.

steps.speaker: Gh0st
steps.text: I’ve got you, Elara. And I waited.
The crew crosses together—five silhouettes stepping into open air. Behind them, the last forced link goes dark.
Morning in the Colony. One regional corridor stands open. Vale and Harmony are gone here; Dominion traffic still moves beyond the sector.
Later, at Zeke’s diner, Nova holds a photograph from their first trip back to Tideglass. In it, Gh0st has one hand on Orion’s shoulder.

steps.speaker: Zeke
steps.text: You caught him like that on our first flight. I thought we’d lost him when the deck tilted.

steps.speaker: Gh0st
steps.text: He was falling. I had a free hand.

steps.speaker: Nova
steps.text: I can’t feel the Source anymore. My ears are still ringing. I remember the rest.

steps.speaker: Orion
steps.text: Stay a while. There’s a breeze through the window.
Outside, the repair crew rolls a ladder across the street. The sound makes Nova turn. For a second she expects the mine bell.

steps.speaker: Zeke
steps.text: They asked if we could spare a hand on the receiver after breakfast. I said we’d come look.

steps.speaker: Gh0st
steps.text: Elara’s already down at the relay yard checking the wiring. She told me to finish breakfast first—and she’d wait.

steps.speaker: Orion
steps.text: Leave it tuned to the corridor. Someone may still be trying to get home.
Nova puts the photograph down and reaches for a cup. The tremor sends it rattling against the saucer. Zeke steadies the saucer with one finger.

steps.speaker: Nova
steps.text: Jed used to hand me the lamp before he asked if I was ready.

steps.speaker: Zeke
steps.text: Are you ready?

steps.speaker: Nova
steps.text: For breakfast. Ask me about the receiver after.
Zeke takes the chair beside her. Through the open window, the repair crew calls for someone to hold the ladder.
STAR BORN
Created by the Starborn team. Thank you for playing.
The outer bypass opens. The alignment rings lock into a single, steady pulse—and twenty years of frost cracks loose from the glass.
Coolant mist spills down the stone steps. Inside the shell, Orion's eyes open to a world that never stopped turning.
He steps out into the mist, gaze drawn upward to the root-tangled vault. Below the stairs, Nova and Zeke stand still—two halves of a twenty-year signal finally in the same room.

steps.speaker: Orion
steps.text: The air smells like rain and cedar. How long did the pod keep me under?

steps.speaker: Zeke
steps.text: Power’s steady. She’s holding.

steps.speaker: Orion
steps.text: Keep her low, under the Shield. I’ll call the turn for the Spire.
The Spire rises above the service lanes. A guidance light turns red.

steps.speaker: Zeke
steps.text: That signal’s pulling us off the lane. I’m on the manual bus.
The deck tilts. Gh0st catches Orion by the harness.

steps.speaker: Nova
steps.text: There’s the city. Take us down below the street lights.
Below the street, rain fills the dents in the Astra’s hull.
The car pulls away. Across the widening gap, Jed holds the override as the blast shutters slam shut.
The shutters seal. Nova keys her radio and waits. Jed’s channel stays silent.

steps.speaker: Zeke
steps.text: Nova. I’m still here. Follow my light.
The Lens burns cold in Nova's palm. High above the Spire, the planetary Shield resolves into rotating chords of light.
It reads her back—tracing a thin, old thread woven straight through her own signal.

steps.speaker: SPIRE SECURITY
steps.text: ANOMALY DETECTED. ARCHIVE CONTAINMENT BREACH. SEALING UPPER TIER.
Blast shutters slam across the glass. Every drone rail lights crimson. The only route left is up to the roof—where the Astra waits.
The rooftop guns fall quiet. The Astra climbs off the rain-slicked pad into the teeth of the Spire's security curtain.

steps.speaker: Orion
steps.text: Through the seam on my count. Three. Two. Now.
The curtain shears across the hull in sparks of crimson and blue. Far above the storm, the planetary Shield still holds unbroken.

steps.speaker: Zeke
steps.text: She's through! I can keep her low under the radar. The Foundry has the engine and cutters we need.
Neon rain gives way to ash and sulfur. Ahead, the Foundry's slag rivers burn beneath iron arches.
The landing struts scrape volcanic glass.
The Anvil answers Nova's scar with furnace heat. Raw Source bends into a lattice of gold and cyan light above the forge.
For one blinding breath, the shape holds—then fractures into drifting sparks across the slag as Gh0st steadies her arm.

steps.speaker: Orion
steps.text: You bent it. One breath is all a bridge needs to begin.
Beyond the Forge walls, heavy hydraulics answer—Rylos is bringing the Titan Walker onto the dock.
The Titan’s hatch hisses open through the smoke. Rylos reaches for a sidearm he can’t lift.

steps.speaker: Gh0st
steps.text: Leave it. There’s a way out behind you.
Gh0st lowers his blade, leaves the hatch open, and turns back toward his crew.
Whatever the Foundry built in these halls, it doesn't own what walks out of them.
The empty engine cradle shakes. Work lights go out along the line.

steps.speaker: Zeke
steps.text: Engine’s holding. Give me the arrays. Now.
The arrays cut a narrow opening. The Deep-Core Engine drives the Astra through before the planetary Shield slams shut.

steps.speaker: Vale
steps.text: Commander Rylos, bring up the ownership register. Director Thorne’s signature is no longer valid.

steps.speaker: Thorne
steps.text: That register includes my name because I paid for everything attached to it. Read it again.

steps.speaker: Vale
steps.text: It includes the authorization you gave me at the Spire. I’ve extended it to the Ring. All sectors, lock down.

steps.speaker: Gh0st
steps.text: The Ring used to announce whose orders I was following. Listen. It’s stopped saying her name.
The Astra drops toward Executive Dock as the Orbital Ring seals its other approaches.
The Anchor comes free. The Hunter-Killer lunges past the tank.

steps.speaker: Nova
steps.text: Gh0st, down!

steps.speaker: Gh0st
steps.text: I’m still here. Can I get you out?

steps.speaker: Elara
steps.text: The tank still has me. Follow my cable to the Throne Room. I’ll hold the door for you.
The Ring’s lights die in long white strips. Every stolen current in the station coils into Vale’s raised hand.

steps.speaker: Vale
steps.text: A choir still leaves room for someone to cry out. One voice. A solo.
The panoramic glass shatters into zero gravity. Behind Vale, space itself splits open into a blinding blue-gold Tear.

steps.speaker: Nova
steps.text: That cable runs straight back to Elara. Gh0st—with me!
The Tear shears straight down through the Anchor Chamber below—shattering the conductive tank. Through the breach, Elara clings to the last live cable as it peels away from the deck.

steps.speaker: Gh0st
steps.text: Elara! Take my hand!

steps.speaker: Nova
steps.text: We’re going after her. Take my arm.
For a second, four hands hold. Then the grip breaks.
Nova wakes beside the blue fire—alone—and reaches into empty air.
Three sets of footsteps reach the fire from different directions.

steps.speaker: Zeke
steps.text: Nova? I’ve got an extra glove. Your hand’s shaking.

steps.speaker: Orion
steps.text: Listen. I can hear all four of us.
Gh0st draws up beside them. Four shadows fall across the Key.
Vale’s knees buckle. His outline cracks, and the sound goes with it.
Two anchors catch the pieces in midair. A new shape pulls itself upright out of blinding white silence.

steps.speaker: Nova
steps.text: Stay together. Check your gear before we go again.
A repaired lead lies across the bench. Jed’s echo leans close to the new solder joint.

steps.speaker: Jed
steps.text: Looks sound. How will you check?

steps.speaker: Nova
steps.text: Power off. Then pull the lead. A joint can look good and still come loose.
Nova checks the switch and tugs the lead. The joint holds. She turns to show him; the place beside her is empty.

steps.speaker: Nova
steps.text: It holds.
